children: The two developments will comprise 2,443 homes across 22 acres, with a combined saleable area of 2.63 million sq ft

Prestige Estates Projects is strengthening its residential portfolio in Bengaluru with two new housing projects that have a combined revenue potential of Rs 2,850 crore, according to a regulatory filing on Friday.
The two developments span 22 acres and comprise 2,443 homes, with a combined saleable area of 2.63 million sq ft. The projects add to the company’s residential development pipeline in Bengaluru.

The company has launched Prestige Parklane, a 12-acre housing project in Devanahalli, Bengaluru, comprising 1,788 homes. The project has a total saleable area of 1.7 million sq ft and carries an estimated revenue potential of Rs 1,750 crore.

The development forms part of the company’s residential expansion in Bengaluru, with the project offering a mix of scale and revenue potential. Prestige Estates has a presence across residential, commercial, retail, hospitality and integrated township developments.

Last week, the company launched another 10-acre housing project comprising 655 premium apartments. The development has a saleable area of 0.93 million sq ft and an estimated revenue potential of Rs 1,100 crore.

With the two projects combined, Prestige Estates has added 2,443 homes and 2.63 million sq ft of saleable area to its Bengaluru pipeline. The developments have a cumulative estimated revenue potential of Rs 2,850 crore.

Prestige Group’s portfolio includes residential, commercial, retail, hospitality and integrated township projects across major Indian cities. As of June 2026, the group had delivered 319 projects spanning 216 million sq ft.
